name: 5G-MAG MBS Examples
what_it_is: A set of Docker Compose examples for deploying 3GPP Release 17 Multicast-Broadcast Services (MBS) on top of a modified Open5GS 5G core, including MB-SMF, MB-UPF, and MBS-capable gNB/UE simulations. It enables end-to-end testing of point-to-multipoint (PTM) and point-to-point (PTP) 5G MBS delivery within a fully containerized environment.
components: AMF with MBS (Access and Mobility Management Function, MBS-enhanced)
SMF + MB-SMF (Session Management Function + Multicast-Broadcast SMF, MBS-enhanced)
UPF + MB-UPF (User Plane Function + Multicast-Broadcast UPF, MBS-enhanced)
Test MBS AF/AS (Application Function / Application Server for MBS testing)
gNB with MBS (srsRAN_Project-based gNB with MBS support)
UE with MBS (srsRAN_4G-based UE with MBS support)
configuration: FIVEG_MAG_MBS_VERSION environment variable (controls MBS-enhanced component image tag)
OPEN5GS_VERSION environment variable (controls standard Open5GS component image tag)
MONGODB_VERSION environment variable (controls MongoDB image tag)
Host IP address in .env file (required for UPF NAT routing)
YAML config files per network function under configs/
Internal mode (full stack including gNB and UE) vs. external mode (core only, accepts external gNB)
modes: Internal deployment: complete end-to-end stack (5G core + gNB + UE) in a single Docker Compose environment
External deployment: 5G core only, accepting connections from an external gNB implementation
constraints: Requires amd64/x86-64 or arm64 host architecture — no other platforms documented
Requires Docker with buildx and compose v2 plugins
UPF and gNB/UE containers require NET_ADMIN capabilities (privileged-mode networking)
Host IP must be manually specified in .env for UPF NAT routing — no auto-detection
MBS-enhanced components are pinned to the '5mbs' development branch of upstream projects, not a stable release
All components run on a single bridge network (10.33.33.0/24) — no multi-host or distributed deployment support documented
notable_absences: No built-in traffic generation or load testing beyond the test MBS AF/AS container
No metrics/observability stack (no Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent)
No documented support for 5G SA non-MBS unicast-only scenarios
No support for N2/N3 interfaces to commercial or third-party RAN other than via the external deployment mode
No SCTP configuration guidance despite SCTP being required for NGAP
No Windows or macOS native support — Linux host assumed
